Method of Attack: Ransomware encryptor targeting Windows and Linux systems
Encrypts files using AES symmetric-key encryption with SHA256 hashing
Uses MSI installer with command-line arguments for Windows infection
Injects ransomware DLL into Windows processes to evade AV detection
Operates in safe mode by copying itself to ProgramData, registering as a service, and rebooting

Excludes specific VMware ESXi files and directories to avoid unbootable servers
Customizes ransom notes with company name and stolen data
Demands ransom payment via Tor onion site

South Korean healthcare, industrial, and pharmaceutical companies
Attack Vector: Execution of MSI installer with special command-line arguments on Windows
Command-line execution on Linux with specific flags to control encryption
Targeted attacks coinciding with Korean public holidays and early morning hours
